title: Velvety Venezuelan Sevaiiya Pudding
description: A sweet and creamy Venezuelan dessert featuring sevaiiya, with a diabetic-friendly glaze, served in a mason jar.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the almond milk, sugar substitute, and vanilla extract, and heat over medium heat until the sugar substitute dissolves.
Add the sevaiiya to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until the noodles are tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the cinnamon and heavy cream.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, stir in the glaze and unsalted butter until well combined.
Spoon the pudding into mason jars and serve chilled.
Garnish with additional cinnamon, if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
